description: This file contains class and function definitions related to the DWARF2/3 debug information reader, including handling of call frame information, debugging entries, and associated handler interfaces.

classes.name: LineInfo
classes.description: Handles reading and processing of DWARF line number information, invoking callbacks in a handler.

classes.name: LineInfoHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling events during line info processing, such as directory and file definitions, and line entries.

classes.name: CompilationUnit
classes.description: Represents a DWARF compilation unit, responsible for parsing DIEs and attributes.

classes.name: Dwarf2Handler
classes.description: Interface for handling parsed DWARF debug info entries and attributes.

classes.name: CallFrameInfo
classes.description: Parses and processes DWARF call frame information for stack unwinding and exception handling.

classes.name: CallFrameInfo::Handler
classes.description: Interface for reporting call frame rules and related data during CFI parsing.

classes.name: CallFrameInfo::Reporter
classes.description: Reports errors and issues encountered during CFI parsing.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins parsing the section data, reporting entries to the handler.

methods.name: ReadHeader
methods.description: Reads the header of line info or CFI data.

methods.name: ReadLines
methods.description: Reads the line number program data.

methods.name: ProcessOneOpcode
methods.description: Processes a single line info opcode.

methods.name: ProcessDIE
methods.description: Processes a single Debugging Information Entry.

methods.name: ProcessAttribute
methods.description: Processes a single attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ReadEntryPrologue
methods.description: Parses the initial length and id of a CFI entry.

methods.name: ReadCIEFields
methods.description: Parses the fields of a CIE.

methods.name: ReadFDEFields
methods.description: Parses the fields of an FDE.
